question: Of which of the following states / UTS is Rauf a folk dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rauf** is a traditional folk dance of **Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• It is performed mainly by women during the spring season and on various festive occasions.
 
• The dance is characterized by its rhythmic movements and is often accompanied by folk songs.
 
• Rauf is an integral part of the cultural heritage of Jammu and Kashmir and reflects the region's rich traditions and customs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The dance is usually performed in groups, with participants forming two rows and moving forward and backward in sync with the music.
 
• The costumes worn during the Rauf dance are often colorful and traditional, adding to the visual appeal of the performance.
 
• Rauf is also known as "Rouf" in some regions and continues to be a popular cultural expression in Jammu and Kashmir.
